requirements.requirement: Provide tidy storage for sewing supplies (compartmentalized organizer)
requirements.evidence: 3-cell L-shaped base (piece:0,0,0; piece:1,0,0; piece:0,1,0) with 3 bins: hex-bin-full-div2 (2 compartments for scissors/tape measure), hex-bin-full-div3 (3 compartments for bobbins/buttons/small notions), and hex-bin-full (open bin for larger items like pin cushion/fabric scissors). Caps and joint bolts secure assembly.
Tape measure and tweezers placed successfully (prop:1, prop:2) showing sewing/craft use. Other sewing-specific props not in catalog; 3D-printed bins provide the intended tidy compartments.

finish.summary: Built compact 3-cell sewing organizer with subdivided bins for sorting small notions, tools and larger supplies. Dressed with tape measure and tweezers to illustrate use; mesh clear and joints locked.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
